name: Windows IPv4 Source Routing Disabled
description:
Ensures Windows does not allow processing of IPv4 source-routed packets by verifying DisableIPSourceRouting is configured to a secure value (2).
Required Windows permission (remedy only): the LEA agent account must be allowed to run reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v DisableIPSourceRouting (administrator rights) via a delegated run-as permission, Scheduled Task, or service configuration.

_remedy.command: reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v DisableIPSourceRouting /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f | Out-Null; reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v DisableIPSourceRouting
